title: Agents, Distributors and Partners
summary: How firms oversee agents, distributors and programme partners who act on their behalf, and remain responsible for their compliance and conduct.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How firms oversee agents, distributors and programme partners who act on their behalf, and remain responsible for their compliance and conduct.
Learning Objectives: Explain the firm's responsibility for agents and distributors
Design onboarding, registration and monitoring of agents and distributors
Assess risks in embedded finance and partner programmes
Syllabus: Agents versus distributors: roles and regulatory treatment
Due diligence, registration and fitness of agents
Embedded finance, programme managers and white-label models
Intended Audience: Compliance officers, MLROs and risk managers at payment institutions and e-money issuers
Finance, operations, safeguarding and fraud teams responsible for day-to-day controls
Directors, senior managers and founders of payment and fintech firms
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of payments, e-money or compliance is helpful. No prior knowledge of specific payment services rules is required.
Core Reading: CPMI, Fast Payments: Enhancing the Speed and Availability of Retail Payments (2016)
FATF, International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation: The FATF Recommendations (as updated)
CPMI and World Bank, Payment Aspects of Financial Inclusion (2016)
